info.name: Deferendum
info.summary: Understand and participate in community decisions
info.description: Development candidate: a read-only Dashboard and a native workspace for selected Deferendum groups. Optional explicit permissions enable discussion reading and participation: concerns and urgency ratings, arguments and reactions, wording proposals and support, governing rules and voting. Each member connects separately; existing read-only grants are never upgraded automatically. Actions require confirmation and source role, phase and version checks. The hosted participation adapter is not yet deployed or publicly available. No persistent private-content cache or default telemetry is maintained. The hosted service and the Nextcloud administrator remain separate trust boundaries.
info.author: Nick Dragoi
